title: Holiness in Daily Life
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Holiness in daily life means belonging wholly to God in thoughts, desires, conduct, relationships, speech, and priorities. Believers are called to be set apart for God because He is holy.
summary: Holiness in daily life means belonging wholly to God in thoughts, desires, conduct, relationships, speech, and priorities. Believers are called to be set apart for God because He is holy.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the holy Savior who cleanses His people and makes them His own. He does not save sinners so they can remain unchanged, but to form a people zealous for good works and devoted to God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Holiness is not limited to outward religious appearance. It reaches the whole life. God calls His people to be set apart in heart, body, mind, speech, sexuality, relationships, work, worship, and conduct.

Holiness flows from belonging to God. Believers do not become holy to earn God’s ownership; they pursue holiness because Christ has redeemed them and the Spirit is at work in them.

This doctrine also rejects cheap grace. God’s grace forgives and trains. It teaches believers to renounce ungodliness and live in a way that honors the Lord in ordinary life.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people separate spiritual life from daily conduct. They may think holiness belongs only to church settings or obvious moral issues. Scripture calls the whole person to belong to God.

This doctrine protects believers from both legalism and compromise. Holiness is not self-righteous performance; it is grateful, Spirit-enabled devotion to the holy God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Offer your daily life to God. Ask Him to search your habits, desires, words, entertainment, relationships, and private thoughts. Turn from what defiles, pursue what pleases Him, and remember that holiness is possible only because Christ cleanses and the Spirit strengthens.
